I saved the chart to **`docs/revenue.png`**. That's the path the README already pointed to, but the file didn't exist yet, so the README now shows the chart.

It shows monthly revenue for 2026, rising from **$41.2k in January to $71.8k in December**. February and October each dip slightly from the month before. Only the first and last bars are labelled with values; the y-axis gives the scale for the rest.

To redraw it after `data/sales.csv` changes, run `python3 src/plot_revenue.py`. I added that script. It reads the data through the existing `revenue_series()` in `src/charts.py` and uses matplotlib. I haven't committed anything.
